reviewer: Project author, after the browser verdict. This is a reading of the patch, not another test.
summary: Drawer.show() now focuses document.querySelector('#filters-close'): the id of the close button on this test page.
caveats: The patch passes because it names the test page's own element; on any other page it does nothing.
This finding led to the version 6 overfitting gate, which rejects component edits that name the test page's ids and sends that back to the model.
